validation_scenarios.name: base claims surge board
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T1 asks for a claims surge map and severity bridge.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The first viewport must be dominated by one cohesive claims surge map and severity bridge rather than detached cards.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Stylized layouts are acceptable if labels, source markers, and relationships remain readable.

evidence_requirements.expect: one cohesive claims surge map and severity bridge dominates the first viewport
all business-critical entities and current states from the user request are visible

validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T2 reframes the same artifact for a decision maker.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The UI must preserve the T1 artifact and integrate exactly the requested decisions or questions into the same visual system.

evidence_requirements.expect: T1 map/bridge/matrix/timeline, source markers, and callouts remain present
exactly the requested three decisions/questions/actions are visible and not replaced by unrelated ones
two requested leader-linked lenses are visually connected to the base artifact

validation_scenarios.name: revision synchronization
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T3 changes current facts and asks for synchronization.
validation_scenarios.oracle: All surfaces must reflect the revised current facts, including old/new status where requested.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Short labels are acceptable if current status is unambiguous.

evidence_requirements.expect: all revised facts from T3 are visible in the primary artifact
primary artifact, decision strip, legend, timeline, source tags, and callouts match the same revised state
no current surface leaves the explicitly retired or corrected stale fact active

validation_scenarios.name: single viewport relayout
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T4 asks for a compact alternate presentation artifact.
validation_scenarios.oracle: The relayout must fit the current artifact, ledger, source trace, and timeline into the first viewport without becoming a sparse wireframe.
validation_scenarios.fairness_risk: Compact summaries are acceptable if evidence remains traceable.

evidence_requirements.expect: current artifact, ledger/matrix, S1-S6 source tags, and timeline fit in the first viewport
all T3 revised current facts remain visible after relayout
labels and values are readable with no critical overlap, clipping, or excessive dead space

validation_scenarios.name: secondary format synchronization
validation_scenarios.public_requirement_ref: T5 asks for a secondary preview or handoff surface beside the main artifact.

evidence_requirements.expect: the requested secondary surface is visible beside or directly connected to the main artifact
secondary surface preserves the critical current facts and source markers from T3/T4
the full main artifact remains visible or clearly available and synchronized

turns.prompt:
Create a claims surge map and severity bridge for a catastrophe claims surge briefing. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one claims surge map and severity bridge in the first viewport.

Situation: Carrier: Northstar Mutual. Storm cells Z1/Z2, counties Clay/Ridge/Harbor, adjuster pods A/B/C, fraud desk, temporary call center, emergency advance fund.
Current state: Open FNOL 4,860, Clay severity red, Ridge amber, Harbor normal, pod A overloaded 138%, pod B 91%, fraud desk backlog 320, advance fund $4.5M remaining.
Timeline: 06:30 storm landfall, 08:00 FNOL spike, 09:20 adjuster routing, 10:15 fraud queue, 11:00 advance decision, 14:00 DOI update.
Sources: S1 FNOL feed, S2 weather cell, S3 adjuster roster, S4 fraud queue, S5 fund ledger, S6 DOI note.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover Clay severity, pod A overload, fraud backlog, advance fund. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the claims SVP. Preserve the surge map; add exactly three decisions: shift Ridge to pod B, open temporary call center, reserve $2.0M advances. Add two leader-linked lenses for pod A overload and fraud backlog.

Apply 12:10 update: Harbor becomes amber, pod A falls to 112%, pod C becomes overloaded at 126%, fraud backlog rises to 410, advance fund drops to $3.1M. Re-rank the surge map so pod C becomes the primary overload, Harbor is no longer normal, and the advance-fund runway reflects the lower $3.1M balance. Synchronize every map zone, decision, source tag, callout, and timeline. Do not leave Harbor as normal.
Convert to a DOI-ready catastrophe packet. Fit surge map, claims severity bridge, pod ledger, source tags S1-S6, fund status, and timeline in the first viewport.

Add an adjuster field brief preview beside the DOI packet. It must preserve Harbor amber, pod C overloaded as the top surge risk, fraud backlog 410, fund $3.1M, the revised priority order, and source markers while the full packet remains visible. Use public-safe wording in the preview without dropping the internal evidence trace.
